steps.caption: Open Leases, then the Calendar tab.
The count at the top: milestones in the date range, confirmed only.
Choose the dates: from and to.
Narrow it to one lease, one company or one property.
Or one event type — for example lease expiry.
Grouped by month: each date, its type and the lease — here the demo leases' expiries.
Tick Include unverified to add calculated and needs-review dates. They keep their label so you never mistake them for deadlines.
Assigned to me shows only leases you look after.
